reviews.title: Eternal loop for Watch Another Video
reviews.text:
I really enjoy this app and appreciate how well it supports Bible knowledge testing. However, the Watch Another Video feature rarely works correctly. Each time I tap Watch Another Video, it simply reloads the same screen, creating a loop with no new video. It becomes discouraging after several attempts.

This is a great app with strong potential, and fixing this issue would make it even better.

reviews.text: I love this game and learning more about God’s word,but the endless Ads just ruin it. There are Ads between every single level and while it takes no time at all to answer three questions per level, Ads of course take a little longer. The extremely sad thing is that one can hardly find a game anymore that isn’t loaded down with Ads. Before, after and during the levels. I was hoping this one would be different, but sadly it’s not. When you spend even more time watching Ads than being able to play the game it becomes tedious very quickly.

reviews.title: Really Challenging but a few notes
reviews.text:
I started playing this game about two years ago and I’ve since started a regular challenge with one of my friends where we see who can score the most points in a certain time! It’s a really fun game, especially when you advance more in the quizzes because the questions get more challenging. 
Regarding the question of the day: We started this competition about a year ago and as you can imagine we’ve run through all of the question of the day questions several times. I will admit there are some I still get a bit tripped on (specifically the questions where we have to cite the verse), but for the most part we know all of the answers to the questions already so it’s starting to lose its charm. I’d like for there to be more questions in the question of the day rotation to increase engagement and the challenge. 
I think something that might also help would be if there was an option to change the Bible translation for the quiz questions. It seems the default is the KJV, but I know many people who read in various translations because of how complex the KJV is. So someone who knows the answer in another translation would get it wrong in the KJV because they don’t know the word (I.e me because it has happened to me several times lol)
Overall, this app is a great way to text your Bible knowledge but if you plan to use it regularly, there will be some repetition and challenges but definitely give it a try and test it out for yourself !
